answer: Cross-epoch trace consistency gate: each identity signs responses to random tasks every epoch; its timing and choice pattern must match its prior commitments or rewards freeze until replay. Challenges rotate through a per-epoch cipher, so copied answer tables fail next epoch. A lotus-shaped cluster detector flags identities reusing one trace. The reef check rejects divergent traces without auditable replay. Attacker cost: separate storage, compute, and elapsed epochs to build each identity’s trace; cloning one trace across many IDs is caught.
